expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: A solid black horizontal bar runs across the bottom navigation bar, overlapping and obscuring the middle (search/bookmark) tab icons, making them unreadable and likely untappable.

The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time or price row, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it. The card ends abruptly at the image.
Bottom navigation items have icon-only representation with no text labels, and the obscured middle item gives no indication of its purpose or active state.
In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol…') with the image and price also clipped by the screen edge, and it is unclear it is scrollable.
Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circular background on the ramen card, dark/transparent background on the pizza card, reducing visibility against light imagery.
Thumbnail treatments are inconsistent — the Green Bowl Poké image sits on a light grey background while the other cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look unfinished.
The category chip row is cut off at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, giving the impression of a broken layout.
